text: The greatest war is the war against ignorance.
author: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk

text: Either I conquer Istanbul, or Istanbul conquers me.
author: Fatih Sultan Mehmed

text: The moving finger writes; and, having writ, moves on: nor all thy piety nor wit shall lure it back to cancel half a line, nor all thy tears wash out a word of it.
author: Omar Khayyam

text: The more you learn, the more you earn.
author: Warren Buffett

text: The work you do with love and dedication will stand forever.
author: Mimar Sinan

text: Knowledge is to understand who you are; if you know not yourself, what use is learning?
author: Yunus Emre

text: To chart the unknown, one must sail with courage and precision.
author: Piri Reis

text: The path to truth requires effort, patience, and an open heart.
author: Hacı Bektaş Veli

text: The knowledge of anything, since all things have causes, is not acquired or complete unless it is known by its causes.
author: Ibn-i Sina

text: Do not be satisfied with the stories that come before you. Unfold your own myth.
author: Mevlana Jalaluddin Rumi

text: If you want to learn, don’t be afraid to ask, even if you fall off the donkey.
author: Nasreddin Hoca

text: Seek knowledge with the fire of your heart, and let it guide your soul.
author: Ahmet Yesevi

text: It’s not that I’m so smart, it’s just that I stay with problems longer.
author: Albert Einstein

text: Be less curious about people and more curious about ideas.
author: Marie Curie

text: I have not failed. I’ve just found 10,000 ways that won’t work.
author: Thomas Edison

text: Learning never exhausts the mind.
author: Leonardo da Vinci

text: I know that I am intelligent, because I know that I know nothing.
author: Socrates

text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
author: Aristotle

text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
author: Confucius

text: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
author: Isaac Newton

text: You cannot teach a man anything; you can only help him find it within himself.
author: Galileo Galilei

author: Nikola Tesla

text: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
author: Winston Churchill

text: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

text: The function of education is to teach one to think intensively and to think critically.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
author: Nelson Mandela

text: Whatever you are, be a good one.
author: Abraham Lincoln

text: You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

text: The only thing worse than being blind is having sight but no vision.
author: Helen Keller

text: Once you learn to read, you will be forever free.
author: Frederick Douglass

text: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
author: Steve Jobs

text: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
author: Elon Musk

text: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: One child, one teacher, one book, one pen can change the world.
author: Malala Yousafzai

text: Imagination is the discovering faculty, pre-eminently. It is that which penetrates into the unseen worlds around us.
author: Ada Lovelace

text: A man who dares to waste one hour of time has not discovered the value of life.
author: Charles Darwin

text: There is nothing like staying at home for real comfort, but there is nothing like going out for real improvement.
author: Jane Austen

text: One cannot think well, love well, sleep well, if one has not dined well.
author: Virginia Woolf

text: I am my own muse, the subject I know best.
author: Frida Kahlo

text: You may encounter many defeats, but you must not be defeated.
author: Maya Angelou

text: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
author: Søren Kierkegaard

text: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Dare to know! Have the courage to use your own understanding.
author: Immanuel Kant

text: The only fence against the world is a thorough knowledge of it.
author: John Locke

text: Judge a man by his questions rather than by his answers.
author: Voltaire

text: Beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing, there is a field. I’ll meet you there.
author: Rumi

text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Lao Tzu

text: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
author: Sun Tzu

text: We are twice armed if we fight with faith.
author: Plato

text: Reserve your right to think, for even to think wrongly is better than not to think at all.
author: Hypatia

text: I will not be triumphed over.
author: Cleopatra

text: I am not afraid; I was born to do this.
author: Joan of Arc

text: I praise loudly, I blame softly.
author: Catherine the Great

text: Every great dream begins with a dreamer.
author: Harriet Tubman

text: Truth is powerful and it prevails.
author: Sojourner Truth

text: You must never be fearful about what you are doing when it is right.
author: Rosa Parks

text: You cannot shake hands with a clenched fist.
author: Indira Gandhi

text: Create the kind of self that you will be happy to live with all your life.
author: Golda Meir

text: You can do a lot if you’re willing to take responsibility.
author: Angela Merkel

text: The best way to not feel hopeless is to get up and do something.
author: Barack Obama

text: Success isn’t about how much money you make; it’s about the difference you make in people’s lives.
author: Michelle Obama

text: Ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
author: John F. Kennedy

text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
author: Theodore Roosevelt

text: The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

text: Motivation is the art of getting people to do what you want them to do because they want to do it.
author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

text: You are not here merely to make a living. You are here to enable the world to live more amply.
author: Woodrow Wilson

text: Perseverance and spirit have done wonders in all ages.
author: George Washington

text: I find that the harder I work, the more luck I seem to have.
author: Thomas Jefferson

text: There is nothing impossible to him who will try.
author: Alexander the Great

text: Experience is the teacher of all things.
author: Julius Caesar

text: Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of fools.
author: Napoleon Bonaparte

text: To have another language is to possess a second soul.
author: Charlemagne

text: A man’s greatest work is to break his enemies, to drive them before him, to take from them all the things that have been theirs.
author: Genghis Khan

text: If you want to achieve greatness, you must be prepared to sacrifice.
author: Saladin

text: Learning is a plant that grows in all soils.
author: Akbar the Great

text: Never leave an enemy behind, or it will rise again to fly at your throat.
author: Shaka Zulu

text: The art of victory is learned in defeat.
author: Simón Bolívar

text: My best soldiers are those who think for themselves.
author: José de San Martín

text: I was born a slave, but nature gave me the soul of a free man.
author: Toussaint Louverture

text: Learn, learn, and learn again.
author: Vladimir Lenin

text: To read too many books is harmful, but to study one book thoroughly is beneficial.
author: Mao Zedong

text: The true revolutionary is guided by great feelings of love.
author: Che Guevara

text: The only ones among you who will be really happy are those who have sought and found how to serve.
author: Albert Schweitzer

text: Do your little bit of good where you are; it’s those little bits of good put together that overwhelm the world.
author: Desmond Tutu

text: Not all of us can do great things. But we can do small things with great love.
author: Mother Teresa

text: The purpose of our lives is to be happy, and happiness comes from learning and growing.
author: Dalai Lama

text: Your work is to discover your work and then with all your heart to give yourself to it.
author: Buddha

text: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
author: Jesus Christ

text: Seek knowledge from the cradle to the grave.
author: Muhammad

text: Whatever kind of seed is sown in a field, prepared in due season, a plant of that same kind, marked with the peculiar qualities of the seed, springs up in it.
author: Guru Nanak

text: Doing good to others is not a duty, it is a joy, for it increases our own health and happiness.
author: Zoroaster

text: The great man is he who does not lose his child’s heart.
author: Mencius

text: There is a time for many words, and there is also a time for sleep.
author: Homer

text: One word frees us of all the weight and pain of life: That word is love.
author: Sophocles

text: The wisest men follow their own direction and listen to no prophet guiding them.
author: Euripides

text: Fortune favors the bold.
author: Virgil

text: Let your hook be always cast; in the pool where you least expect it, there will be a fish.
author: Ovid

text: Seize the day, put no trust in the morrow.
author: Horace

text: The desire for glory clings even to the best men longer than any other passion.
author: Tacitus
